requirements.text: Reconcile execution against the live simple-chats branch, record the exact starting SHA, and stop for bundle repair when source drift changes the planned ownership or tests.
Treat this as a behavior-preserving refactor. Do not add new end-user behavior, routes, menus, filters, or product concepts.
Do not consume, inject, reference, call, map, or render the Simple Chat/LlmChats product API, domain, persistence, routes, or SSE surface in production UI.

Preserve every existing Agent Chat flow, copy, action, state transition, keyboard interaction, scrolling behavior, overlay behavior, and error path unless an explicit parity record proves a necessary internal-only delta.
Stop after Phase 1 proof and user handoff. Do not begin the Simple Chat UI integration phase.
Create an application-owned neutral conversation presentation boundary, preferred as src/UI/CanDoItAll.Conversations.Components.
The neutral boundary must not depend on AgentFramework Models/Core/Voice, Modules.AgentFramework, Modules.LlmChats, EF Core, AppDbContext, persistence, provider SDKs, or runtime services.
Use CodeAnalytics dependency evidence before and after project-reference changes and reject any cycle or inward dependency.
Use small immutable presentation records, opaque keys, explicit callbacks, and focused render fragments instead of backend entities or mutable service-owned state.
Keep domain mapping, service calls, command execution, cancellation, persistence, and lifecycle effects in agent-owned adapters or orchestration components.
Do not create a boolean-parameter god component, service-locator UI, dynamic backend switch, reflection-based adapter, or generic interface whose only implementation is the old monolith.
Keep existing public AgentFramework component entry points as compatibility facades until all existing consumers and owner tests have migrated.
Extracted presentation behavior must be directly testable without constructing AgentChatPanel, the full web host, provider runtimes, persistence, or a real agent execution.
Do not add new AgentChatPanel, ChatWorkspacePanel, FloatingAgentChatHost, or AgentDetailsDialog partial files to hide responsibility growth; prefer independent types and adapters.
Preserve stable data-testid values, accessible names, visual hierarchy, scroll owners, and CSS behavior. Record any unavoidable DOM delta before implementation and prove equivalent interaction.
Extract a neutral participant card that accepts presentation data and action/adornment slots rather than AgentDefinition.
Extract a neutral compact participant list and item using opaque stable keys and presentation callbacks.
Extract reusable search, tag-filter, favorite, and picker presentation only where semantics are genuinely source-neutral.
Keep agent teams, capabilities, workload, status policy, provider privacy, approval counts, managed-agent identities, and favorite persistence in agent-owned mapping or slots.
Convert AgentSelectionCard, AgentCompactList, and AgentCompactListItem into thin compatibility adapters or replace their internals without breaking their existing callers.
Preserve AgentCatalogPanel and AgentSwitchDialog filtering, ordering, favorites, team selection, double-click behavior, managed-agent actions, copy, and test selectors.
Neutral contracts must not assume Guid agent identity; use an opaque string or dedicated source-neutral key.
Extract neutral conversation thread rail, list item, search, count, empty, loading, and error presentation.
Preserve selected thread, new-thread creation, refresh, title editing, search filtering, switching, and current agent workspace behavior.
Represent agent-only pending-approval, auto-approval, and execution badges through adapter-provided metadata or adornment fragments.
Preserve bounded history loading, active-session indication, history dialog selection, and open-thread behavior.
Extract neutral message, transcript, header, status, empty-state, and safe markdown presentation.
Extract neutral composer chrome, prompt text area, draft state, send-disabled state, send action, and validation/status region.
Expose focused slots for agent execution activity, approvals, voice, attachments, prompt gallery, runtime diagnostics, and extra header/composer actions.
Keep UserRequestMarker and hidden-context parsing in the agent adapter; the neutral component receives explicit visible content and optional context presentation.
Preserve message role labels, timestamps, token estimates, copy behavior, tooltips, focus, keyboard behavior, auto-scroll, overflow, and large-desktop layout.
Preserve run, send, cancel, approval, title, attachment, voice, and runtime-detail callbacks and do not alter backend orchestration semantics.
Keep ChatWorkspacePanel as an agent-facing facade that composes neutral components and agent-only slots; do not duplicate backend logic inside the neutral project.
Extract a reusable conversation-definition editor shell with configurable sections and action slots.
Extract reusable identity/avatar/name/summary/instructions fields with configurable labels so a future caller can use System prompt without binding this phase to LlmChats.
Extract provider/model selection presentation through neutral provider/model option records; retain ProviderProfile mapping in an AgentFramework adapter.
Prepare a neutral temperature field and optional advanced-settings slot. Keep thinking-effort and provider-specific settings in adapters unless represented by source-neutral options.
Keep agent status, workload, chat history, approval policy, Memory, Images, capabilities, tools, skills, governance, and other agent-only tabs in AgentDetailsDialog ownership.
Separate generic active-chat retention/capacity presentation from agent-only prepared activation stock and preparation-budget semantics.
Extract floating catalog/window/list presentation seams that can later host multiple participant sources without adding those sources now.
Keep IFloatingAgentChatCoordinator, context registry, context access, affinity, history, handle lifecycle, preparation, and workspace services in the agent host adapter.
Do not add Agents/Simple Chats filter controls, mixed catalogs, new tabs, badges, or labels in the production UI.
Do not add the future Add context action, project-structure capture, current-node/subtree selection, or context injection behavior.
Preserve overlay size, placement, state persistence, close versus stop semantics, hide/reopen behavior, active limits, retention, and current context-affinity behavior.
At execution, load the current CanDoItAll.SharedInfo skills and record their active hashes; do not rely only on the preparation-time hashes.
Use code_analytics_impacted_tests_get with only actual diff files and one-based changed line ranges; put inspected-but-unchanged files in contextOnlyPaths.

Call impacted-test analysis first with behaviorIntent Unknown; use BehaviorPreservingImplementation only after the conservative result resolves the intended body-only change and the assertion is justified.
Verify workspace health, nonzero source/test discovery, resolved changed symbols, nonzero test discovery, and run every required selector.
Honor conditional-selector promotion triggers. Do not replace impacted-test evidence with habitual broad solution or project runs.
Use isolated bUnit/component tests, affected project builds, and focused browser proof at the named checkpoints; add missing owner tests when extraction creates a new test seam.
Run an unfiltered Stable/full gate at most once and only when CodeAnalytics returns a workspace/all-suite requirement or a recorded invalidation trigger makes affected-scope proof insufficient.
Pass neutral-boundary source guards, phase-exclusion guards, dependency/cycle review, architecture review, and bundle validators.
Validate at a named maximized or large-screen desktop viewport and inspect normal plus relevant open-overlay states; preserve existing responsive behavior without adding mobile scope.

Produce a manual regression checklist covering Agent catalog, switcher, sessions, chat, approvals, execution details, attachments, prompt gallery, voice, floating chats, settings, contextual windows, and Process workspace consumers.
Final implementation state must be awaiting-user-agent-chat-regression, not ready-for-simple-chat-ui.
The next Simple Chat UI bundle is blocked until the user confirms Agent Chat parity after running the application.
Document future Simple Chat mapping and streaming/context extension seams, but leave them unregistered, unreferenced, and unused in production.
